symbol_precision.measures: of the declaration entities the engine emitted, how many the fixture labels
symbol_precision.denominator: emitted declaration entities, with repository-structure entities held out and counted

symbol_recall.measures: of the declarations the fixture labels, how many the engine emitted

definitions.measures: of the labelled declarations, how many an incoming structural edge points at

calls.measures: of the labelled call sites, how many produced a call relation
calls.denominator: labelled call sites, counted with multiplicity

references.measures: of the labelled uses of a name, how many produced a reference relation

imports.measures: of the labelled import bindings, how many produced an import relation carrying the same module and alias

imports_module_retained.measures: of the imports whose module path must survive resolution, how many still carry it
imports_module_retained.denominator: labelled imports whose module the graph has to be able to name

members.measures: of the labelled type members, how many a structural edge reaches from the owning type

inheritance_subject.measures: of the labelled `inherits`/`implements` clauses, how many produced an edge naming both the base and the type that declared it

inheritance_base.measures: of the labelled `inherits`/`implements` clauses, how many produced an edge naming the base at all

negative_references.measures: of the labelled non-references, how many the engine kept non-references

negative_inheritance.measures: of the labelled types that declare no base, how many carry no inheritance edge
negative_inheritance.denominator: labelled types that declare no base

incremental.measures: of the rows in an incrementally-refreshed index, how many are identical to a full build of the same tree
incremental.denominator: entity and relation rows, summed over an edit, a delete and a rename, both indexes counted

query.measures: of the query assertions, how many the surface answered correctly
query.denominator: the hand-written assertions, plus two derived from every labelled call that resolved

context.measures: of the context questions, how many the pack answered by naming the right entity
context.denominator: labelled context questions, including the ones that must be refused as ambiguous
